actionable_stories.event: Putin at SPIEF (St. Petersburg Economic Forum) live right now (18:00 UTC): 'Russia is ready and wants to negotiate with Ukraine peacefully on basis of Anchorage summit agreements.' 'Gas can flow through surviving Nord Stream pipe tomorrow — just push the button, contract still active.' Putin announces Russia-US tunnel project between Chukotka and Alaska. Announces forthcoming Russia-China energy deals. Says 'rumors about Russian economy problems are greatly exaggerated.' Mark Rutte (NATO Secretary General) in Kyiv. Simultaneously: Ukrainian drone attack footage released of corvette 'Boykiy' being hit in Kronstadt (St. Petersburg naval base) — DURING the SPIEF forum. ASupersharij posted the strike footage 16:38 UTC. Russian border patrol ship 'Svetlyak' hit in Crimea overnight. ATB regional warehouse (entire Dnipro + Zaporizhia supply chain) destroyed by Russian ballistic missiles. Drones targeted St. Petersburg during forum opening. UK (London) lifted sanctions on Raiffeisenbank depositary — TASS reports.
actionable_stories.consensus_narrative: Putin's SPIEF speech is being framed as a peace overture — 'ready to negotiate on Anchorage,' 'Nord Stream can restart,' 'Russia-US tunnel,' 'China energy deals.' The London Raiffeisen sanction lift signals Western thaw. Putin is 'winding down' the war. Markets interpret: European gas prices will fall on Nord Stream talk, Russian assets bid on peace premium, Ukraine war ending.
actionable_stories.contradiction: While Putin performs peace theater at SPIEF, Ukraine struck the Russian Navy at Kronstadt — the naval base of St. Petersburg, the very city hosting the forum. This is not a symbolic jab with a drone; this is a corvette hit inside Russia's most fortified naval hub. The message: Ukraine is escalating, not negotiating. The Anchorage framework demands Ukrainian neutrality and territorial concessions — Kyiv has already rejected this. Nord Stream cannot 'just push a button' — no certification, no insurance, no political will in Europe to restart it. It's a price manipulation statement, not an operational one. The Russia-US tunnel is fantasy. The Raiffeisen lift is one bank, not a trend. Ukraine struck St. Petersburg DURING the forum — the real signal is escalation, not de-escalation.
actionable_stories.bet: SHORT RSX (Russia ETF) into the SPIEF close. Putin's peace theater unwinds immediately when the forum ends and no Kyiv delegation appears. LONG Ukrainian wheat futures — the ATB warehouse destruction is a real supply chain event that reduces Ukrainian export capacity at a time of tightening global grain stocks. The drone footage of Kronstadt hit proves Ukraine has no interest in freezing the conflict — grain supply disruption premiums will reprice upward.

The US-Israel-Iran triangle is the key: every Hezbollah rocket at Netanyahu makes a ceasefire less likely, not more.
